main.summary: Outcome of conditionally finalizing deletion for a catalog item instance.

field.name: Removed
field.summary: The matching pending-delete item was removed.

field.name: AlreadyAbsent
field.summary: No catalog item with the requested ID exists.

field.summary: A different item instance currently owns the requested ID.
